profile_connect_mcp_caveat: Replace the URL with your own deployment if it differs.
profile_connect_mcp_claude_description: Adds an HTTP MCP server entry. The CLI walks you through the OAuth flow on first use.
profile_connect_mcp_codex_description: Add this to ~/.codex/config.toml, then run codex mcp login projectproject to connect your account.
profile_connect_mcp_gemini_description: Add this entry to ~/.gemini/settings.json. The CLI handles OAuth on first request.
profile_editor_description: Where branch links open across the app. GitHub is the default.
profile_editor_hint_cursor: Branch links open a clone prompt in Cursor. Desktop editors can't jump straight to a branch, so this clones the repo instead.
profile_editor_hint_github: Branch links open the branch on GitHub in a new tab.
profile_editor_hint_github_dev: Branch links open the branch in github.dev, the browser-based editor, in a new tab.
profile_editor_hint_vscode: Branch links open a clone prompt in VS Code. Desktop editors can't jump straight to a branch, so this clones the repo instead.
profile_everhour_description: Connect an Everhour API key so ProjectProject can create board projects and tasks for time tracking.
profile_github_connected_description: Branch and PR actions use this account.
profile_github_description: Connect your personal GitHub account to create branches and pull requests as yourself.
profile_github_error_account_already_lin: This GitHub account is already connected to another ProjectProject user.
profile_github_error_email_mismatch: This GitHub account uses a different email address. Try again.
profile_github_error_expired: The GitHub connection expired. Start again.
profile_github_error_missing_profile: GitHub didn't return enough account information. Try reconnecting.
profile_section_connected_agents_descrip: Apps that can read your projects and act on tickets through the MCP API. Revoke any you don't recognize.
profile_section_security_description: Passkeys and two-factor will live here once Better Auth's plugins are wired up.
